content.short: Mini Royale: Nations is a free-to-play FPS browser game.
content.description: Mini Royale: Nations lets players level up through PvP battles, collect Heroes and Weapons via the Battle Pass, and complete Challenges and Contracts to unlock high-rarity Heroes in the Fusion Lab. Team up for Clan Wars to win skins and SOL. Matches include a 3-minute Team Deathmatch or Capture the Flag with up to nine players, with other modes, including PvE, coming soon. The game follows a seasonal cadence with new maps, Battle Passes, Hero and Weapon collections, and recurring Challenges and Contracts every few months. No NFT, wallet, or account is required to start, and Mintable Hero and Weapon skins can be unlocked for free.
content.meta: Mini Royale: Nations is a free-to-play FPS browser game and a decentralized gaming project. Discover Mini Royale: Nations and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
